setlist_extra.title: That's It For The Other One

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls this Dark Star from the piece's creative peak, with the pedal like shutters banging in a storm; Reviewer calls the Dark Star beautiful [10][13]
- **Turn On Your Lovelight** (1 review): Lovelight sounds either pitched down or Pigpen is extremely drunk; the performance is gritty and raw [6]
- **Saint Stephen** (1 review): Saint Stephen has a slow, solid opening where the band, especially Bobby, sounds deeply engaged, despite a splice near three minutes [12]
- **The Eleven** (1 review): The Eleven is described as rowdy and hard-rocking [4]
- **Cryptical Envelopment** (1 review): Reviewer rates the Cryptical > Other One > Cryptical sequence possibly among the best ever played [4]

## The recordings

- **gd69-01-17.sbd.clugston.3115.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 10 songs; 85 min; rated 3.91/5 by 23 [1]. Said about its sound: Loud, clanky bass drum pedal in the mix repeatedly distracts from an otherwise energetic performance; Bass drum pedal noise is severe, like banging from outside; reviewer couldn't listen and wants a remix; Pedal noise is a problem, and several cuts of unknown length interrupt the music [5][7][8][9][11][13]
- **gd69-01-17.sbd.miller.89798.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 7 songs; 84 min; rated 4.09/5 by 11 [2]

## Around the show

- Pigpen seems very drunk this night, yet is at times brilliant; Jerry plays fiercely [8]
- Show rated just below the late February to early March 1969 Live Dead run, which merits top marks [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-01-17.sbd.clugston.3115.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Master soundboard reel to cassette to DAT to CDR, extracted and shrunk to SHN by Scott Clugston [1]
- **gd69-01-17.sbd.miller.89798.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe B. Jones; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD [2]. Also: This version repairs cuts in Lovelight and St. Stephen with crossfades, fixes levels, and applies pitch correction with Joe B. Jones's help [2]
